titulo: Prova da Unidade 6 (B1) — How it's made

leitura.texto:
HOW OUR CHOCOLATE IS MADE
Cacau Real was founded in 1931 in Ilhéus, Bahia, by a family of cocoa farmers. The first chocolate bars were made by hand in the family kitchen. In 1968, a modern factory was built, and today 25 tons of chocolate are produced every day.
The cocoa beans are grown on small farms in the south of Bahia. After harvest, they are fermented for six days and dried in the sun.
At the factory, the beans are cleaned and roasted at 130 degrees. Then they are broken into small pieces, called nibs. The nibs are ground into a thick paste, which is mixed with sugar, milk powder and cocoa butter.
Once the mixture is ready, it is heated and cooled several times. This process is called tempering, and it must be controlled very carefully: if the temperature is wrong, the chocolate loses its shine.
Finally, the chocolate is poured into moulds, cooled and wrapped. Every batch is tested in the lab, and batches that are out of spec can't be sold.
Our chocolate is sold in Brazil and exported to twelve countries.

falas.en: What is this machine used for?
It's used for cutting the steel sheets. They're cut with a laser.
falas.pt: É usada para cortar as chapas de aço. São cortadas a laser.

falas.en: They were made in Japan. They were installed three years ago.
falas.pt: Foram fabricadas no Japão. Foram instaladas há três anos.
E o que acontece depois do corte?

falas.en: The pieces are bent, welded and painted. Then they're sent to the assembly line.
falas.pt: As peças são dobradas, soldadas e pintadas. Depois são mandadas para a linha de montagem.

falas.en: Yes. The first piece of each batch must be measured, and every hundredth piece is checked by the quality team.
falas.pt: Sim. A primeira peça de cada lote deve ser medida, e a cada cem peças uma é verificada pela equipe de qualidade.

Conte a história de uma empresa ou cidade usando a passiva no passado (was founded, was built, was bought…).

foco_avaliacao: Nível B1. Voz passiva no presente (is/are + particípio), no passado (was/were + particípio), com modais (must be, can't be, should be), com by; made of/from, used for + -ing; descrever processos com sequenciadores (First, Then, Once, Finally); vocabulário de qualidade.
